params.prompt: Edit the supplied reference into a clean isolated 3D asset reference. Preserve the original object identity, soft rounded premium cozy style, warm cream, sage, wood and muted gold palette, and the same three-quarter viewing angle. Retain a compact grouped composition containing ONLY a sage-green calculator with cream keys and a muted peach operation key, a small cream notebook with subtle checkmarks and charts, a few overlapped paper sheets and one sage-and-gold pen diagonally on the notebook. REMOVE ALL sticky notes / post-it notes and REMOVE the binder clip, any loose extra clips and any unnecessary extra items. Group the calculator beside the notebook and papers compactly, keep their supporting bases on one common horizontal plane. No extra base tray beneath the composition. Actual transparent alpha background, no background color, no floor, no outer glow, no halo, no ground shadow. Keep subtle self shading and clear geometry. Slightly matte materials, soft even lighting, all object edges fully visible with modest margins. Single asset only. Do not add anything.
